prerequisites: Successfully completed the Organic Chemistry 1 exam.
Good knowledge of the theories of chemical bond and structure of organic compounds.
Good knowledge of physical and chemical properties of mono-functional organic compounds (contents of Organic Chemistry I).

learning_outcomes.text: Study reactions of bifunctional groups and interactions of polyfunctional compounds.
Understand classical and advanced technologies to form new C-C bonds.
Introduction to carbohydrates, proteins and nucleic acids.
Acquire methodological tools to continue their studies and to face more specialized courses.

syllabus_topics: Notes on some fundamental concepts of organic chemistry 1.
Keto-Enol tautomerism and reactions of enolate anions.
Acetoacetic ester and malonic ester synthesis.
Conjugate addition to α,β-unsaturated carbonyl compounds.
Organometallic reactions: Reactions of transition metals for preparation of new carbon-carbon bonds.
Stereochemistry of Glucose: The Fischer Proof.
Amino acids: Chirality and Acid-base properties.
Reaction of an amino-acid with Ninhydrin.
Resolution of Racemic Mixtures of Amino Acids.
Amino and carboxyl -Protecting groups and carboxyl activation.
